n.description: Number of emails to fetch (for check, default 10)

body.description: Email body as Markdown (for send). ![alt](/_upload/… URL) embeds an image from THIS conversation in the text, [name](/_upload/… URL) attaches the file.

attachment.description: Optional (for send): URL of a file from THIS conversation to attach (an uploaded image, or generated sandbox output like a PDF — its /_upload/... URL). To show an image inside the text instead, embed it in the body with ![alt](URL).
